description:
Fact, from fixtures/00622_guard_extern_of_another_class_is_refused.fz at 864b7dbd1: the error "compiler2 guards cannot call extern `sqrt`: parameter class F64 is neither an integer nor a reference word" is reported at 6:1, the `extern "C" defp sqrt(float) :: float` line. The offending code is the guard `when sqrt(x) > 1.0` on line 8. The declaration is fine; the call site is what the reader must change, so the primary span is the guard call, with the declaration as a secondary note.

Acceptance: 00622 asserts the reported line is the guard call. fz-sc8.24 (purity refusal, "not guard-safe") reports through the same path and inherits the fix.
title: A guard-extern refusal points at the extern declaration, not the guard that calls it
